messages:
Taylor: Heads up 10: planning to land docs PR #523 (migration examples + Rust SDK snippet) in the 16:00 docs slot. Netlify preview failed with artifact shard EEXIST.
Evan: saw the deploy error: preview-bot: Build failed for branch docs/rust-sdk-523 1 - EEXIST writing artifact shard. Likely caused by large svg atlas.
Riley: Two quick paths: swap the atlas for tiled PNGs or push a content-only merge. I prefer replacing assets so previews stay green.
Taylor: If Riley can push optimized assets in ~10m, let's wait. Otherwise we'll do content-only merge with `merge: gated` and note in release board.
Evan: I can run a quick mkdocs check locally. Command: `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8002`. Snippet renders fine locally.
Riley: Pushed smaller PNGs and updated alt text. Triggered a redeploy.
preview-bot: New deploy started: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1965432355 (logs: ...)
Taylor: Reviewing content now. Checkers: 1) code snippet compiles, 2) links target stable API refs, 3) migration steps mention cache invalidation.
Evan: Approve for content (left inline nit about a flag name).
Riley: Approve 1 images replaced and alt text fixed.
preview-bot: Deploy succeeded: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/1965432355
Taylor: Merging at 16:03. Reminder to include `docs-release` in merge commit and add an item to the release notes board for the Rust SDK example.
Evan: Will run a quick smoke on the live site for 404s.
Riley: I'll open follow-up PR to add high-res tiled assets with CDN headers.
Taylor: Closing thread.
